Reach for this skill when building agent workspaces, configuring channels, managing sessions, creating skills, automating tasks with cron/webhooks, or troubleshooting agent behavior. metadata: mintlify-proj: clawdbot version: "1.0" --- # OpenClaw (clawdbot) Skill ## Product summary OpenClaw is a self-hosted AI agent gateway that bridges messaging platforms (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, iMessage, Signal, Mattermost, and more) to LLM-powered agents. The Gateway runs as a single process on your machine or server, routing inbound messages to an agent that can execute tools, manage sessions, and automate tasks. The agent is built on the pi SDK and uses a workspace directory (`~/.openclaw/workspace` by default) to store operating instructions, memory, and configuration. Key files: `~/.openclaw/openclaw.json` (config), `~/.openclaw/agents/<agentId>/sessions/` (chat history), workspace files (`AGENTS.md`, `SOUL.md`, `TOOLS.md`, `MEMORY.md`). Primary docs: https://docs.openclaw.ai
